name: tidy-chats
description: Keeps the desktop app's Code-tab sidebar tidy during normal chat turns: pins chats in progress, files them into sections, marks finished ones done and archives them, and learns from your undos.

sweep_hours.title: Hours between sweeps
sweep_hours.description: How long after the last sweep a chat's Stop starts the next one.

finished_idle_hours.title: Archive finished chats after (hours)
finished_idle_hours.description: A chat titled done: or handed off: is archived once idle this long.

idle_days.title: Archive any idle chat after (days)
idle_days.description: Any chat with no activity for this many days is archived.

archive.title: Archiving
archive.description: auto archives in the sweep; ask lists the archives as one yes/no question.

routine_titles.title: Routine run titles (regex)
routine_titles.description: Chats whose title matches are routine runs: never pinned, archived after 1 hour idle. Empty: none.
